common.compactBGInSyncDesc: Automatically compress vertical space for background vocal lines during synchronization.
common.wrapLyricLinesDesc: Wrap lyrics to the next line when they exceed the editor width instead of scrolling horizontally.
common.keepPlayingWordInView: Always Keep Playing Word in View
common.keepPlayingWordInViewDesc: Automatically scrolls the lyric editor during playback to keep the active line and playing word visible.
common.allowConsecutiveBackgroundLines: Allow consecutive and standalone background vocals
common.allowConsecutiveBackgroundLinesDesc: Export consecutive background vocals together and preserve standalone background vocals for Spicy Lyrics compatibility. Other players may not support this structure.
common.openSpotMatchAfterSaveDesc: Automatically open the SpotMatch track finder after saving a TTML file with Ctrl+S or Cmd+S.
common.autoLoadCloudAudio: Load audio when opening cloud saves
common.autoLoadCloudAudioDesc: Automatically load attached audio or match local audio files when loading from cloud saves.
common.downloadAudioOnLyricImportDesc: Automatically search and download matching audio tracks into the app when importing lyrics.
common.neverSplitWordsDesc: Words listed here will never be split into syllables or segments across all songs in the app. Separate words with newlines or commas.
common.neverSplitWordsPlaceholder: e.g. baby, forever, superman (one word per line or comma-separated)
common.syncJudgeModeDesc: Set how timestamps are judged when syncing. Default is 'First key down'.
common.keyBindingTriggerDesc: Determines whether shortcuts are triggered when a key is pressed or released.
common.syncTimeOffsetDesc: Adjust all sync timestamps by this amount to compensate for audio latency.
common.syncCommitOffsetDesc: Specific offset for the 'Commit' action to fix delayed audio issues.
common.smartFirstWordDesc: When syncing the first word of a line, the first key press sets its start time only, without immediately setting its end time.
common.smartWordAnywhereDesc: When syncing any word without a start time, pressing the Next key (G) acts on the prior word to set its end time and start this word.
common.smartLastWordDesc: When syncing the last word of a line, the key press sets its end time without automatically setting the start time of the next line's first word.
common.splitOccupiedWordAtPlayhead: Split Word at Playhead on Sync
common.splitOccupiedWordAtPlayheadDesc: When pressing the Sync Next trigger (G) while the playhead is inside a timed word, update that word's end time to the playhead and start the next word there to prevent timing errors.
common.autoSplitTrailingSpaceDesc: Automatically split a trailing space into a dedicated space capsule when editing or typing words.
common.enableUpcomingWordHighlightDesc: Fades in a highlight color shortly before a word plays during Sync mode to improve precision.
common.customBackgroundDesc: Choose an image to use as the background.
common.customBackgroundOpacityWarning: If this value is too high, the page content may be hard to read.
